verdict: FAIR-TO-RICH at $172 — red's CONCLUSION survives but on blue's arithmetic, not red's, and the correction moves the gate 17%. Blue pulled the full audited XBRL series where red had read only the 10-Q six-month columns: owner earnings are $454.4M TTM, not red's $381.6M, so EV/OE is 24.6x, not 29.3x/46.0x — the original brief's 25.2x was RIGHT and red's refutation was a seasonality artifact (annualizing the weak half). Gate ladder on corrected owner earnings: 20x=$143.0, 22x=$155.8, 25x=$174.9 — i.e. 25x sits ABOVE the tape, and red's $122.6 'gate' was simply the 52-week low reached by the same annualization error. Also surviving: the Elliott leg is struck (undated, unsized, no 13D); the FY26 buyback 'increase' is flat-to-down vs FY2025 actual and funded at a THIRD of the required pace; capital allocation runs 1.9x into third-party paper; capex +42% and DTA runoff push forward normalized OE toward ~30x.
